name: temple_of_enlightenment_scry_top_keeps_order_then_taps_for_u
notes: Pa628282112 G4. Printed: 'When this land enters, scry 1.' and '{T}: Add {W} or {U}.' Answering 'top' leaves seat 0's library order as it was. On seat 0's next turn the Temple has untapped, and it pays Aegis Turtle's {U}, the second option of its mana choice. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act).
